title: Visa 10.4 Evidence Requirements - Card-Absent Fraud
content: Demo sample only. For a card-absent fraud dispute, useful evidence may include AVS result, CVV result, device fingerprint, IP address, account login history, delivery confirmation, prior undisputed transactions, customer communication, and proof that the purchased goods or services were provided to the same customer account.

title: Visa 10.4 Rule Summary - Fraudulent Transaction
content: Demo sample only. Reason code 10.4 is represented here as a card-absent fraud scenario where the cardholder claims they did not authorize or participate in the transaction. The response should focus on authorization signals, authentication results, customer identity linkage, fulfillment proof, and prior transaction history.

title: Precedent - Visa 10.4 Digital Goods Account Match
content: Demo sample only. A merchant successfully challenged a card-absent fraud dispute by showing the disputed purchase was made from an existing customer account, the account had prior undisputed purchases, the device fingerprint matched earlier activity, and the digital goods were accessed shortly after purchase from the same IP range.

title: Visa 13.1 Evidence Requirements - Merchandise or Services Not Received
content: Demo sample only. For a merchandise-or-services-not-received dispute, useful evidence may include shipment tracking, delivery confirmation, signed proof of delivery, service usage logs, pickup confirmation, customer communications, refund policy disclosure, and evidence that the delivery address matched the order details.

title: Precedent - Visa 13.1 Carrier Delivery Confirmation
content: Demo sample only. A merchant prevailed in a not-received dispute by providing carrier tracking that showed delivery to the verified shipping address, a delivery timestamp before the dispute date, package weight matching the product, and customer support messages acknowledging the shipment.

title: Mastercard 4837 Evidence Requirements - No Cardholder Authorization
content: Demo sample only. For a no-cardholder-authorization dispute, useful evidence may include authorization approval, 3-D Secure authentication result, AVS/CVC checks, device and IP telemetry, customer account history, delivery or usage proof, and evidence connecting the transaction to the cardholder or authorized user.

title: Mastercard 4837 Rule Summary - No Cardholder Authorization
content: Demo sample only. Reason code 4837 is represented here as a fraud dispute where the cardholder denies authorization. The response package should emphasize authentication, transaction authorization, identity linkage, and fulfillment or usage evidence.

title: Mastercard 4855 Evidence Requirements - Goods or Services Not Provided
content: Demo sample only. For a goods-or-services-not-provided dispute, useful evidence may include order confirmation, service completion records, delivery confirmation, customer usage logs, appointment attendance records, refund or cancellation terms, and correspondence showing the cardholder received the expected value.

title: American Express F24 Evidence Requirements - No Cardmember Authorization
content: Demo sample only. For a no-cardmember-authorization dispute, useful evidence may include authorization approval, fraud screening result, customer authentication signals, account tenure, prior successful transactions, shipping or usage evidence, and written customer communications tied to the transaction.

title: Precedent - American Express C08 Goods Returned Dispute
content: Demo sample only. A merchant partially prevailed in a returned-goods dispute by providing the return policy shown at checkout, timestamped delivery records, inspection notes showing the returned item was materially different from the item shipped, and support messages explaining the partial refund decision.
citation_label: Demo Precedent - Amex C08 Return Policy

title: Discover UA02 Evidence Requirements - Fraud Card-Absent Transaction
content: Demo sample only. For a card-absent fraud dispute, useful evidence may include authorization response, fraud screening decision, AVS/CID checks, device fingerprint, billing and shipping match, delivery confirmation, customer login records, and transaction history linking the cardholder to the order.

title: Discover RG Evidence Requirements - Non-Receipt of Goods or Services
content: Demo sample only. For a non-receipt dispute, useful evidence may include proof of delivery, service usage records, signed pickup confirmation, shipment tracking, customer support correspondence, order confirmation, and evidence that the merchant fulfilled the order before the dispute was opened.
